title: On Travelling to the coast twice a year
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：travel　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 travel 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the ranger ① travelled to the coast twice a year in the rain, and every villager in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the ranger ② travels to the coast twice a year without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ travel to the coast twice a year at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ travelled to the coast twice a year before — a line in the survey for October 1944 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Travelling to the coast twice a year in the rain, the ranger said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ travel three miles before the light goes without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Travel three miles before the light goes at once and never mention it again.

By 1957 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the survey, and a new villager from the next valley ⑧ travels three miles before the light goes in the rain every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ridge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ travelled to the coast twice a year again when nobody else would.

⑩ To travel to the coast twice a year, my mother said in 1962, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody travels to the coast twice a year without complaint again and somebody must travel to the coast twice a year in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 旅行（一般过去式 travelled to the coast twice a year：1950 年守林人头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 旅行（一般现在 travels to the coast twice a year：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 旅行（不定式 to travel to the coast twice a year：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 旅行（过去完成时 had travelled to the coast twice a year：1944 年十月的踏勘记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 旅行（动名词 travelling to the coast twice a year 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 行进（travel three miles before the light goes：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去行进天黑前走出三英里）
G. v. 行进（travel three miles before the light goes：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 旅行（后段两处：新来的村民照例 travels three miles before the light goes，而母亲又一次 travelled to the coast twice a year）

answers.why: travel 意为“旅行”，1950 年守林人淋着雨旅行一年去两次海边，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 travelled。
travel 意为“旅行”，自那以后守林人毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 travels。
travel 意为“旅行”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯旅行一年去两次海边”，此处为不定式 to travel to the coast twice a year。
travel 意为“旅行”，踏勘记录里 十月 那行字说明早在 1957 年之前就有人旅行过，故用过去完成时 had travelled。
travel 意为“旅行”，守林人说“旅行一年去两次海边这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 travelling to the coast twice a year 作主语。
travel 意为“行进”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去行进天黑前走出三英里”，should ever 之后用原形 travel three miles before the light goes。
travel 意为“行进”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻行进天黑前走出三英里（travel three miles before the light goes at once），以后再也不要提起。
travel 意为“旅行”，新来的村民每个季节都照例行进天黑前走出三英里，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 travels。
travel 意为“旅行”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨旅行一年去两次海边，用一般过去式 travelled 叙述。
travel 意为“旅行”，结尾那句是母亲 1962 年的话：要旅行一年去两次海边，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 travel 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the ranger travelled to the coast twice a year in the rain, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the ranger travels to the coast twice a year without complaint whenever the valley asks.
Travelling to the coast twice a year in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever travel three miles before the light goes without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new villager from the next valley travels three miles before the light goes in the rain every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother travelled to the coast twice a year again, and the valley remembered that half.
